entries.title: Job 16:1
segments: ¶Then Job answered and said:

entries.title: Job 16:2
segments: "I have heard many such things; Miserable comforters [are] you all!

entries.title: Job 16:3
segments: Shall words of wind have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?

entries.title: Job 16:4
segments: I also could speak as you [do], If your soul were in my soul's place. I could heap up words against you, And shake my head at you;

entries.title: Job 16:5
segments: [But] I would strengthen you with my mouth, And the comfort of my lips would relieve [your grief].

entries.title: Job 16:6
segments: ¶"Though I speak, my grief is not relieved; And [if] I remain silent, how am I eased?

entries.title: Job 16:7
segments: But now He has worn me out; You have made desolate all my company.

entries.title: Job 16:8
segments: You have shriveled me up, And it is a witness [against me]; My leanness rises up against me [And] bears witness to my face.

entries.title: Job 16:9
segments: He tears [me] in His wrath, and hates me; He gnashes at me with His teeth; My adversary sharpens His gaze on me.

entries.title: Job 16:10
segments: They gape at me with their mouth, They strike me reproachfully on the cheek, They gather together against me.

entries.title: Job 16:11
segments: God has delivered me to the ungodly, And turned me over to the hands of the wicked.

entries.title: Job 16:12
segments: I was at ease, but He has shattered me; He also has taken [me] by my neck, and shaken me to pieces; He has set me up for His target,

entries.title: Job 16:13
segments: His archers surround me. He pierces my heart and does not pity; He pours out my gall on the ground.

entries.title: Job 16:14
segments: He breaks me with wound upon wound; He runs at me like a warrior.

entries.title: Job 16:15
segments: "I have sewn sackcloth over my skin, And laid my head in the dust.

entries.title: Job 16:16
segments: My face is flushed from weeping, And on my eyelids [is] the shadow of death;

entries.title: Job 16:17
segments: ¶Although no violence [is] in my hands, And my prayer [is] pure.

entries.title: Job 16:18
segments: "O earth, do not cover my blood, And let my cry have no [resting] place!

entries.title: Job 16:19
segments: Surely even now my witness [is] in heaven, And my evidence [is] on high.

entries.title: Job 16:20
segments: My friends scorn me; My eyes pour out [tears] to God.

entries.title: Job 16:21
segments: Oh, that one might plead for a man with God, As a man [pleads] for his neighbor!

entries.title: Job 16:22
segments: For when a few years are finished, I shall go the way of no return.
